types.name: item_tax_lines
types.description: The tax lines to set for line items.

children.name: rate_id
children.description:
The associated rate's ID.
When integrating with a third-party, you don't need to provide it.
This is mainly used for the built-in rates.

children.name: rate
children.description: The rate of the tax line.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the tax line.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the tax line.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the tax provider used to calculate and retrieve the tax line.

children.name: data
children.description:
Additional data returned by the tax provider.
Use this to store jurisdiction-level breakdown data
(e.g. state, county, city rates) that is not captured in the aggregated rate.

children.name: line_item_id
children.description: The associated line item's ID.
